zh-CN.title: 邮件提醒更清晰
items: 验证码邮件使用更醒目的专属验证码版式
未读消息按发送者归纳，并可一键返回对应会话
邮件自定义预览升级为接近真实收件效果的排版

en.title: Clearer email reminders
items: Verification emails now use a dedicated, prominent code layout
Unread messages are grouped by sender with a direct return to the conversation
Custom email previews now mirror the actual inbox presentation
